title: Autonomous Agent Platform
baseDescription: `Autonomous multi-agent coding platform — a self-hosted fork of OpenHands, running in production.` `11.6k lines of React 19` across `142 files`, `334 commits ahead of upstream`.

cards.text:
`Live event streaming over WebSocket.` An agent's `tool calls`, `file edits` and `terminal output` render as they happen — `Monaco` and `xterm` panes read the same event log, state in `Zustand`, server cache in `TanStack Query`.

`Lazy chat history:` replaced full WebSocket replay with `REST pagination plus tail-only replay` — long conversations stopped re-streaming their entire history on open.

`Sub-agent editor on a transport abstraction:` one UI drives either a `live sandbox` or a `plain host folder`, so `agent roles` can be edited before any container exists.

`Shipped the whole operator surface:` `autonomy switcher`, agent stop control, per-run task strip, `git-worktree status badges`, subscription usage widget, project dashboard and scheduled messages.

`Kept the fork healthy:` migrated to `ESLint 9 flat config` ahead of upstream and drove the suite fully green — `2,400+ tests` — after fixing `MSW double-interception` and an env leak in `Vitest`, with `translation completeness across 15 locales` enforced in the pre-commit gate.

`Backend under it:` `FastAPI` services for projects, scheduling, usage and `git-worktree isolation per agent run`, `Docker` sandboxes, and deploy with `zero public surface` — Tailscale, Caddy, systemd, cron — with health check and auto-rollback.

title: Mercury Properties
baseDescription: `Kazakhstan's largest commercial real-estate holding — 51+ properties and 1M+ m² under management` — now building its own digital products for business.

cards.text:
`MercuryX` — a turnkey `B2B platform` for sourcing and importing from China, part of the `Halyk ecosystem`.

`Built the full Halyk Market integration`, rewrote the `business logic` behind it, and owned `product pricing` and `cost calculation` across `supplier price`, `logistics` and `customs` — the numbers the entire import flow runs on.

`Shipped the commerce path end to end:` authentication, cart and order flow, unit-tested.

`Rebuilt a barely viable MVP` into a platform that scales: `modular feature-based architecture`, no more shipping the whole app up front.

`Initial load: 2.5 MB → 650 KB.` Set up the `code-review system` and automated the routine out of the developer workflow.

`CarCity` — an `auto-parts e-commerce marketplace` with delivery across Kazakhstan.

`Cut SSR incidents` and emergency hotfixes `4× in two months`, then `documented` architecture, features and business logic — `onboarding stopped running on tribal knowledge`.
`Migrated the whole project` from stock `Nuxt` to `Feature-Sliced Design`: less boilerplate, clear module boundaries, and `+120% feature velocity` for the team.

title: Solution Architects
baseDescription: `Company specializing in scalable backend solutions and infrastructure optimization.`

cards.text: `Delivered several MVPs` with a team of senior engineers — `architecture`, `code review`, `data model` and `service layer` through to `UI`. `Implemented architectural patterns` for efficient `database transactions`, improving consistency and simplifying system usage.

`Built admin panels` on internal APIs, a `multi-time-zone marketing calendar` with its `scheduling logic`, and the `CI/CD pipeline on AWS` that ships them.

`Wired Jira to GitHub` — linked environments, `ticket → branch → PR`, automated checks — and deleted the manual steps from the team's day.

title: POWR.io
baseDescription: `POWR.io offers customizable website plugins to enhance small businesses' online presence.`

cards.text:
`Built customizable website plugins` and dynamic UI in `React` on a `Node.js` and `Ruby on Rails` backend — a `40% lift in plugin sales`.

`Generated 1M+ localized landing pages` in `12 languages`: `SEO` rankings up, inbound engagement doubled.

`Moved image resizing to serverless` — faster responses, smaller hosting bill.

`Built the integration system` that automated `chat notifications`, `ticket updates` and `CI/CD docs`, and `mentored` mid and junior engineers in a fully remote US team.

title: WoCards.app
baseDescription: `MVP mobile app for learning English by a flashcard system.` Led a small team, chose the stack and set up CI/CD from scratch.

title: NCRM GROUP
baseDescription: `NCRM — a simple CRM for systematic sales.` Started as `Project Manager`, leading the sales-conversion and productivity statistics module now used by `50+ companies`, then moved into engineering.

cards.text: `Built the front-end infrastructure` and `prototype` for a CRM project. The `MVP` is used by a company with over `2000+ employees`, and standardized practices kept the codebase consistent as the team grew.

Significantly increased `code maintainability` and support by writing the project documentation. 

 Integrated `web chat` inside CRM with popular messengers, such as `Whatsapp` and `Telegram`. Utilized free and premium APIs of those messengers for companies to communicate with their customers through our chat interface.
